purpose: Resume scientific work across terminals and expose compact review evidence
publication_rule: Explicit reviewed path allowlist plus staged size/type/credential checks; never git add -A
large_artifact_rule: Keep files locally; publish relative location, bytes, SHA256 and restoration role. A manifest does not prove USB backup.
transport_verification: unverified until actual destination bytes match
history_rule: No force pushes, no merging scientific tracks for synchronization, no automatic clean/reset/delete
